discontinued_classifier: KNN; historical code and results retained, excluded from active evaluation
roc: one-vs-rest from saved predict_proba values; macro averages defined class curves; micro pools one-hot decisions
missing_classes: classes with no positive or no negative examples have no individual ROC curve and are listed in undefined_roc_classes; macro averages valid class curves only
top1: mean over the full supplied observation manifest; highest probability candidate correctness per observation; observations with no candidates count wrong
